notes: Sub-tasks are visible without opening the task. Any task with steps now shows a count you can click to unfold them right there in the list, with a checkbox on each one, so you can tick things off as you go instead of opening the task every time. Ticking a step updates the task's progress straight away, and the list stays folded by default so a long Timeline is still readable.
You can also add sub-tasks while creating a task, rather than having to save it, reopen it and edit it. If you start from a template, its steps and any you type yourself both come through.
